title: intent init points at --help for the family notes of the templates it did not write, and --help has none
body:
Found on 2026-09-24 by vc's subagent driving `docs/getting-started.md` for the 3.2.1 doc audit, on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: `intent init` ends its listing with "(3 embedded template(s) deliberately not written -- run with --help for the family notes)" (`render.rs:8528-8533`), and `intent init --help` prints no family notes. The per-template reasons exist -- `skipped: Vec<(&str, &str)>` at `init.rs:146-148` -- and nothing prints them, so the pointer sends the reader to a page that does not hold what it promises.

Expected: the reasons are printed where the pointer says, or the pointer names where they are.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line; outside the shipping-grade test of hv decision 33 (1).
